map.K-Means 代价估算器，输入样本与簇中心估算聚类惯性 inertia(簇内平: K-Means cost estimator: enter samples and cluster centres to estimate clustering inertia (within-cluster sum of squares), for assessing cluster compactness and choosing k.
map.Inertia 估算 ≈ n·dim·spread²/k；每簇样本 ≈ ⌈n/k: Inertia estimate about n·dim·spread²/k; samples per cluster about ceil(n/k)
map.在样本近似均匀分布的假设下，簇内平方和随 K 增大按 1/k 衰减，可用于快速预: Assuming samples are roughly evenly distributed, the within-cluster sum of squares decays by 1/k as K grows, allowing a quick estimate of how many clusters are needed. With real data of varying cluster density, set K by business meaning rather than only looking at the metric inflection.
map.惯性 inertia=Σ‖x−μ_k‖²(簇内平方和 WCSS)，越小聚类越紧致: Inertia = Σ‖x−μ_k‖² (within-cluster sum of squares, WCSS); smaller means tighter clusters.
map.inertia 随 k 增大单调下降，需用拐点(手肘)或轮廓系数选 k。: Inertia falls monotonically as k grows, so use the elbow (inflection) or the silhouette coefficient to choose k.
map.K-Means 对初始中心与异常值敏感，常多次初始化取最优。: K-Means is sensitive to initial centres and outliers, so it is common to initialize several times and take the best result.
map.：k=2 时 inertia=500, k=3 时=300, k=4 时=220: : inertia = 500 at k = 2, 300 at k = 3, 220 at k = 4. Inertia keeps falling, and the drop from k = 3 to 4 (80) is clearly smaller than from 2 to 3 (200), so combined with the business view choose k = 3 or 4.
map.不是。k 越大 inertia 越小，k=样本数时为 0 但失去聚类意义；应兼顾: No. Larger k gives smaller inertia, and at k = number of samples it is 0 but clustering loses meaning; balance compactness against simplicity of cluster count using the elbow or silhouette coefficient.
map.异常值会大幅拉高 inertia 并偏移质心，可先做离群检测或用 K-Medoi: Outliers greatly raise inertia and shift centroids; run outlier detection first or use K-Medoids (distance-median based) for robustness.
